中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> panel plugin v0.6.2"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Overview"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Paper Isle is a sidebar panel plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It puts a personal desk into the left pan"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"el: **sticky notes, paper pages, calendar tasks, drawings and a reusable prompt library** live in on"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"e place, windows move and resize freely, everything saves itself, and the data never leaves your mac"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ce, windows move and resize freely, everything saves itself, and the data never leaves your machine."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"It stays quiet on purpose: no floating toasts, no empty status rows, a theme that follows DSH, and a"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" dark mode rebuilt for paper. It is for people who want a local, offline, exportable workspace witho"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ilt for paper. It is for people who want a local, offline, exportable workspace without leaving DSH."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### Two skins, one product"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Since 0.6.0 there are two skins with identical features, only the look differs: **Paper Isle Classic"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"** (`classic`, the default for existing workspaces — paper surface, handwriting, freely placed notes"},{"id":"p9s3","text":") and **Native Glow** (`modern` — no tape, stamp or paper grain; a very light blue-violet / teal amb"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ience; DSH-native tokens; sticky notes become an ordered grid you can drag, or reorder with `Alt + ←"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"; DSH-native tokens; sticky notes become an ordered grid you can drag, or reorder with `Alt + ←/→`)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Switch in Settings → Appearance → "Desk look". It applies instantly without a page reload; windows, "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"unsaved edits, search terms, the selected calendar day and the current drawing page all survive. A f"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"resh install asks once, each upgrade asks once more, and "Don't remind me again" stops it for good."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Sticky notes"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- Short thoughts, saved automatically; **the whole sheet can be dragged** (except the body text, scr"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ollbar, colour swatches and delete button), and the one you touched last stays on top.
- The body us"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"es the bundled **LXGW WenKai** handwriting face; you can switch to a system face or a paper serif in"},{"id":"p12s4","text":" Settings.
- **The trash keeps notes for 7 days** instead of showing an undo toast — deleted notes l"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"and in the trash at the top of the sticky window and can be put back at any time. Empty notes are dr"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"t the top of the sticky window and can be put back at any time. Empty notes are dropped immediately."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Paper pages"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- Long-form writing with a searchable page list on the left and auto-save.
- A new page's title is a"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" placeholder, not a line of literal "Untitled page".
- **Pinning**: the editor toolbar has Pin / Unp"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"in with `aria-pressed`; pinned pages sort first, the rest stay newest-first. Pinning survives reload"},{"id":"p14s4","text":", export/import and migration."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Calendar and tasks"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- Every task has **four urgency levels** (urgent and important / important / urgent / none), switche"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"d **in place** on the task row without opening a detail dialog.
- **Calendar dots**: unfinished dots"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" sit under the day number and take the level colour; finished dots sink to the bottom of the cell an"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"d turn neutral.
- **Persistent tasks**: a "daily" task reappears once a day from its anchor date; ch"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"ecking in today grows a new unfinished instance tomorrow, while the calendar only shows days you act"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"ually checked in. Future dates are never pre-filled. Finishing the run shows "this one is done", sto"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"ps new instances and can be restored at any time."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Prompt library and composer entry"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Library**: the fifth dock app, seeded with five sample prompts. Search and pin from the list, ed"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"it title and multi-line body on the right, auto-saved. Body limit 20,000 characters, up to 300 promp"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"ts. New / duplicate / pin / delete, with confirmation on delete.
- **Use it while chatting**: every "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"composer has a small "Prompts" button on the left of its tool row. It opens a list above the input; "},{"id":"p18s5","text":"`↑↓` selects, `Enter` fills, `Esc` closes. **It only fills the draft**: an empty draft receives the "},{"id":"p18s6","text":"whole prompt, a non-empty one gets an insert at the caret (single-step undo); a sending composer ask"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"s you to try again in a moment. It never writes the system prompt and never sends by itself."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Drawing paper"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- Freehand drawing with undo/redo, eraser, brush colours and four tip sizes, clear page, delete whol"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"e page and export to PNG; the booklet flips left/right and remembers the current page."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Desk, windows and dock"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Today card** on the right of a wide desk so windows never cover it; it steps aside on narrow pan"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"els.
- **Dock**: the only entry point to the apps; click toggles a window; **icons can be dragged to"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" reorder** (or `Alt + ←/→` when focused; the order is remembered and can be reset in Settings → Appe"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"arance). The house button gathers every window, and pressing it again restores them.
- **Clicking em"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"pty desk** also gathers all windows into the dock (nothing is destroyed).
- **Commands and apps**: t"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"he first item in Settings, reachable with `Ctrl/Cmd + K`; search apps, pages or actions, `↑↓` to sel"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"ect, `Enter` to run.
- **Windows**: Classic has no minimise / maximise / close triple; drag the titl"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"e bar to move and the bottom-right corner to resize; close with `Esc`, `Ctrl/Cmd + Alt + W` or the c"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"ommand list. Native Glow adds explicit minimise and close buttons in the title bar, wired to the sam"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"e window manager actions.
- **First-run tour**: six steps, replayable from Settings → Tutorial."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- Built against DSH **0.2.1-rc.2**.
- Tested on Windows 11 with DSH 0.2.1-rc.2: install, sidebar, pa"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"nel, data retention across reload and view switches, host persistence, export/import.
- CI builds an"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"d runs the page contract, DOM nesting, host route and client syntax checks on **Windows, macOS and U"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"buntu** runners.
- **Not yet exercised on a real macOS or Linux DSH**: the data path uses `DSH_HOME`"},{"id":"p24s5","text":" or `~/.dsh` and there are no platform-specific binaries. Please open an issue if something breaks.
"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"- Chinese and English pages are built from one source; sample content is generated in the language o"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"f first creation, and your own text is never translated."}],"truncated":true}
